g.text: data.topics().forEach(topic->{if (topic.name()==null &&version<12)throw new UnsupportedVersionException("MetadataRequest version "+version+" does not support null topic names.");if (!Uuid.ZERO_UUID.equals(topic.topicId())&&version<12)throw new UnsupportedVersionException("MetadataRequest version "+version+" does not support non-zero topic IDs.");})
